_help: Edit this file to keep branches and Guardians. "branches": one Element-Branch-Subbranch path per line (parents are created automatically; a path with no Guardian shows as a gray box). "guardians": profiles, each filed by its path. "zodiacRoots": names shown left of an element. "overrides": from-path => to-path. The order of first-level branches sets their top-to-bottom order in the diagram (Zodiac roots on the left follow the same order).
